verdict.rationale: dltHub's deployment and orchestration docs say runs can be refreshed and backfilled through a decorator-based Python API, and dlt offers incremental and merge loading, so the backfill part of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows how a backfill works, or that a single table can be resynced or reset without re-running the whole pipeline. missing for 10: evidence of per-table (single-resource) resync or reset, details of how backfill windows work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can backfill history or resync a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs with a familiar decorator-based Python API.
teams schedule, backfill, and chain their pipelines with dltHub.
Incremental loading is the act of loading only new or changed data and not old records that we have already loaded.
